messages:
marta: anyone else seeing preview invoices show negative or wobbling credits for a small subset of tenants? screenshot posted in thread.
ajohnson: yup saw a couple yesterday afternoon, not global. looked like partial aggregation from one of the edge shards then a fallback route hit.
luca: my gut — correlates with that sampling-ttl tweak we shipped last week (reduced to 1h). late-arrivals are getting dropped then fallback path re-emits with different fingerprint.
kevin: can we repro by replaying raw events for a known-affected tenant? i can spin a targeted backfill if we confirm scope.
metering-bot: backfill-queue: enqueued job id 8712 for tenant-x (events 2026-03-10..2026-03-15)
marta: thanks. kevin, please run it for tenant-x first. if backfill heals preview numbers then it's likely TTL/leak.
kevin: running: `python tools/backfill.py --tenant=tenant-x --from=2026-03-10 --to=2026-03-15 --dry-run=false`
ajohnson: alternative mitigation: mark invoice preview rows as "provisional" when they originate from fallback routing + partial-agg window, so console UX doesn't treat them as final.
luca: extension of TTL to 12h would reduce odds of partial-agg, but memory pressure on aggregator increases. need numbers before we flip.
marta: agree on UX-first approach. adding provisional flag buys us time while we measure memory/ops tradeoffs.
kevin: UI note — console currently only shows final charges. adding a subtle pill with tooltip is low-risk. i can PR a preview badge and hover text: "provisional data subject to late-arriving events"
ajohnson: nice. also add telemetry event when provisional appears so we can chart trend and owners.
luca: action items: kevin -> preview badge PR, ajohnson -> telemetry metric + alert if >0.5% tenants affected, me -> run aggregator mem profile with 12h TTL sim, marta -> coordinate post-backfill verification.
marta: timeline? can we get PR + telemetry by EOD tomorrow?
kevin: yep aiming for EOD tomorrow on the UI change.
ajohnson: i'll add a quick metric in the collector pipeline today, then hook to grafana panel.
luca: i'll run sim overnight and post numbers in this thread tomorrow morning.
marta: perfect. thanks all. :thumbsup:
kevin: fyi if backfill fixes tenant-x i'll also add a one-off job to sweep the recent 48h window for other similar tenants.
ajohnson: cool. keep the thread updated if any invoice-preview consumers panic.
marta: noted — i'll DM billing on expected "provisional" flag rollout to avoid support noise.
kevin: done.
